scope: Actual queue business-kind/parameter dispatch, ordered lease/failure batches and partial errors, epoch/order/sealed frames, metadata receipt flag and finalization; actual immutable-capture worker predicate, in-place retain and event/root binding. Native preparation, derived caches, complete mixed/WAL histories and cross-log ownership remain open.

properties.queue_reader::{keep_worker,retire}: The verified callback preserves each entry and returns exactly the complement of the native worker-equality predicate. The resulting table contains exactly all original nonmatching keys and their unchanged values. Invalid reader tables return State without mutation. The same callback body is expanded in stable native and annotated verification builds.
properties.queue_admin::reader_retired: Bind event.worker_id to the readers root, preserving all other queue roots; exact absent-field versus malformed-reader errors and unchanged errors. Missing worker IDs keep native null-index equality semantics, without claiming API admission.
properties.queue_replay::{apply_item,many,batch}: Arbitrary finite batch order, including duplicate IDs; complete success trace or exact completed prefix plus the failing item's partial effects. Leases and failures select their intended arrays, identities and transition. Native deadline removal remains at the original per-item success positions; its cache semantics are tested, not formally modeled.
properties.queue_replay::body: Every recognized type selects the correct operation/parameters. Untouched epoch/order/sealed controls remain unchanged, Sealed sets the flag, unknown kinds return a defined error unchanged, completion binds receipt and lease separately, and yielding is distinct from ordinary progress. Requires supplied kind to equal event.type.
properties.queue_replay::{receipt_flag,finish}: Only the six metadata kinds report an already-recorded request. Finalization leaves that state unchanged and otherwise binds the final event to the requests ledger. Full native cache-stutter and multi-event history composition remains separate.

trusted_library.normal_return: Every original entry supplies an original key/value and a callback result; the result equals final membership, kept values equal callback-final values, and no new key appears. The actual straw predicate and root selection are verified, not trusted.
trusted_library.reviewed_callback: Immutable captures, no entry mutation, native Value equality. No claimed arbitrary mutable-capture state evolution, visitation order or unwind rollback.

library_source.implementation: Delegates retain to the configured map. The runner rejects preserve_order and requires float_roundtrip.

native_capacity_fix.scope: Add missing yield_tasks and release_tasks pre-WAL preflights for the complete new-order count after cached-response lookup; ordinary progress and empty releases allocate none.
native_capacity_fix.witness: Existing native capacity regression extended with valid batch-yield/release requests after forcing the private order counter to usize::MAX. Before the fix the yield batch entered the forbidden write callback and failed. Final code rejects both without state/log changes or quarantine. This is a defensive forced-boundary reproduction, not a practical valid-workload overflow.

negative_controls.reproduce: Copy the crate into an isolated directory. For each case replace its single old guard by the recorded new text in rust/coordinator.rs and run the recorded cargo command. Require the named test to execute and fail with batch capacity rejection must precede writes. Compiler/tool errors are not semantic evidence.

boundaries: Native queue_event::prepare and task-target prevalidation establish caller inputs; only their local functions and the conditional body are verified, not the entire native call chain.

Deadlines has no business-state postcondition. Its independent mutable cache cannot borrow the exclusively borrowed queue value; native removal semantics, usage/pending/leased cache correctness, caller quarantine and unwind correspondence remain unproved.
Request semantics use the existing ledger/content abstraction. Reader retirement uses native Value equality, not canonical byte equality; numbers expose only as_u64 observations.

Complete mixed-event/WAL business-history composition, root extraction, physical catalog ownership, native namespace/File/run/lock binding, GC composition and crash-writer retirement remain unfinished.
No added filesystem operation, persistent format or payload copy. Runtime capacity checks and dispatcher extraction are not a measured zero-overhead guarantee; performance remains deferred.

development_errors_not_evidence: A retain environment mutant that deleted the callback term had no inferable existential trigger. It was rejected as invalid evidence, replaced by an inverted callback-decision mutant and rerun to a semantic assertion/postcondition failure.

Stable Rust rejects expression attributes, so a local macro expands one callback body into the ordinary native closure or its verifier-annotated form. Failed intermediate macro variants are not evidence.

The pinned verifier needed explicit proved unit-value equality before mapping successful Result<(), E> values. No assumption or omitted straw proof was added. Unsupported string literal match syntax was expressed using ordinary if comparisons.
